name: Beef and Rice Stuffed Bell Peppers

components.name: Beef and Rice Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.name: Six raw large bell peppers, trimmed and seeded

steps: Rinse uncooked rice and cook in 530 ml water until almost tender, then let the steam escape so stuffing is not soggy.
Preheat oven to 190 C. Slice the tops off six large peppers, remove seeds and place upright in a lightly oiled baking dish.
Sauté onion and garlic in measured oil, add raw beef and brown thoroughly. Add one third of the passata, the nearly cooked rice and dry seasonings and stir to combine.
Fill each pepper with one sixth of the mixture. Pour remaining passata and broth around the peppers, cover dish tightly with foil.
Bake covered for 35-40 minutes, uncover, sprinkle mozzarella on each pepper and bake another 10-15 minutes until peppers soften and centre of stuffing reaches 74 C.
Pack one generous stuffed pepper and some surrounding sauce per person; cool quickly before freezing.
